name: cc-trans
description: Write and read in your own language while Claude works in English: prompts go out translated, replies come back with a translation, code untouched.

language.title: Your language
language.description: The language you type and read in: a code (ko, ja, zh, es, de, ...) or its name. Empty: follow Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale.

engine.title: Translation engine
engine.description: haiku needs no setup; openai takes any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, LM Studio, DeepSeek); command runs your own program with JSON over stdin/stdout.

view.title: How replies are shown
view.description: auto: side by side when the terminal is wide, else stacked. stacked: each paragraph as Claude wrote it, its translation dimmed under it. interleave: each paragraph followed by its translation. side: English left, translation right. below: English, then the whole translation. translated: translation only. original: English only.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.description: Show the English of your draft above the prompt while you type; Enter then sends it with no wait.

haikuModel.title: Model for the haiku engine
haikuModel.description: The Claude model used by the haiku engine and as the fallback.

openaiBaseUrl.title: OpenAI-compatible base URL
openaiBaseUrl.description: For the openai engine, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.

openaiModel.title: OpenAI-compatible model
openaiModel.description: For the openai engine, e.g. qwen3:8b.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI-compatible API key
openaiApiKey.description: For the openai engine; leave empty for a local server.

command.title: Command engine
command.description: For the command engine: a program that reads {"from","to","lines"} JSON on stdin and prints {"lines"}.

fallback.title: Fall back to haiku
fallback.description: Use the haiku engine when the openai or command engine fails.
